de: Die erste Zeile wird zu $Groups = Get-Service | Group-Object -Property Status. Danach wird Get-Service nicht mehr gebraucht.
Jede Gruppe hat einen Name, das ist der Status, und einen Count. Filtere die Gruppen nach Name und lies Count.
en: The first line becomes $Groups = Get-Service | Group-Object -Property Status. After that Get-Service is not needed again.
Each group has a Name, which is the status, and a Count. Filter the groups by Name and read Count.
$RunningCount = ($Groups | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Running' }).Count and the same with 'Stopped' for $StoppedCount
